key_insight: Armillary qLDPC codes encode more than one logical qubit per two physical data qubits while supporting fixed-connectivity, multi-tier superconducting layouts.
engineering_relevance: The design offers a path to lower data-qubit overhead without requiring reconfigurable connectivity or long-range qubit transport.
method: Generate code structure through hardware-constrained native iSWAP routing.
Jointly enforce stabilizer commutation and correct parallel syndrome extraction.
Use radial and circumferential couplings in crossing-free routing layers across 5–6 hardware tiers.
evidence_signal: Circuit-level simulations of the [[8688,4348,16]] code report a logical error rate of 1.62×10⁻¹² per logical qubit per round at a physical error rate of 0.1%.
watch_item: The results are simulation-based; practical performance still depends on realizing reliable multi-tier couplings and iSWAP routing in superconducting hardware.
paper_title: Rate-1/2 Quantum LDPC Codes for Multi-tier Superconducting Hardware
